answer_2.quote: Following the previous work , we use Holder F1, Target F1 and Exp. F1 for the token extraction of Holders, Targets and Expressions. For structure prediction, we use Sentiment Graph F1 (SF1) and Non-polarity Sentiment Graph F1 (NSF1) to evaluate the model, which perform exact match evaluation on the full sentiment tuple (h, t, e, p) and non-polarity tuple (h,t,e).

answer_3.quote: In Table , we present a comparative analysis of our method against ChatGPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT4. The results indicate that on the English dataset, GPT4 surpasses the baseline performance in a zeroshot setting and shows further improvement with in-context learning (1-shot or more).
